verdict.summary: The change correctly makes the cross-repository keepalive body extractable and extends the existing hermetic harness to execute that exact workflow script. The new assertions are outcome-based and non-vacuous: they independently pin the watched workflow set, stale dispatch behavior, both live statuses, unreadable-live-check behavior, fresh-run behavior, and the complete repository/workflow/ref dispatch argv by equality. The shared spec parser refuses missing, empty, or malformed lists, and the generalized runner preserves the existing registry-leg coverage while recording complete dispatch calls. I found no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect in the diff.
